label: Clip reel

kinds.video: One clip, full frame, with its own sound. No card before or after; a title shows as a lower third only when the scene has one.

fields.video: The video clip (.mp4, .webm or .mov) from the project assets.
fields.title: Optional lower-third text (the ON SCREEN line of a scene script). Leave it out for a clean frame.
fields.in: Where in the clip to start, in seconds.
fields.out: Where in the clip to stop, in seconds.
fields.sound: Plays the clip's own sound; the scene lasts as long as the clip. On by default in a reel.
fields.caption: A reel shows no captions; the field is kept so an explainer scene can be pasted in unchanged.
fields.hold: Seconds (0-4) of quiet after the clip ends: the scene keeps the last frame that long. Set by New from script to fill a scene's span.

description: A film cut from generated or filmed clips only, each full frame with its own sound: no title card, no end card, no subtitles. Made by New from script when the script has no TITLE line and no End card; the Director never writes one.
